title: Cam’ron Attacked by WWE Superstar Jey Uso During ‘It Is What It Is’ Episode: ‘I Don’t Smell What the Uce Is Cooking’
summary: Killa Cam will be making an appearance at WrestleMania 42.
contentText:
Cam’ron isn’t smelling what the Uce is cookin’. Cam and Mase had WWE superstar Jey Uso join It Is What It Is for an interview on Thursday morning (April 16), but tensions rose when Uso felt disrespected by Cam’s line of questioning.

Related

WWE Superstar Liv Morgan’s Looking for ‘Trouble’ in Her Music Video Ahead of WrestleMania 42

Lil Yachty Defends Himself From Fan Backlash Over WWE ‘SmackDown’ Debut: ‘Something I Love So Dearly’

Uso had enough when Cam wanted some Sunday (April 19) WrestleMania main event talent in the It Is What It Is studio instead of Uso, who’s wrestling at WrestleMania 42 on Saturday (April 18) as part of a tag-team match.

Jey Uso hopped up and dragged Cam over the desk and began assaulting him on the ground, while others attempts to break up the altercation, which appears may have been staged as promo for WrestleMania 42 in Las Vegas.

“Listen, Mase, I actually don’t have anymore questions. Nick, I’m more mad at you because you keep bringing Saturday WrestleMania n—as here and you don’t bring us a Sunday,” Cam said to his producer. “I need a Sunday WrestleMania and I don’t smell what the Uce is cooking.”

Jey Uso quickly jumped up in a fury, dragged Cam over the desk and slammed him to the floor as chaos broke out in the studio. “He tripping,” Uso continued to repeat as he stepped away from the scuffle after landing a couple of light punches.

Billboard has reached out to Cam and WWE’s reps for comment.

Staged or not, fans found the interaction hilarious. “That’s how Cam pulled ol boy out the car in Paid In Full ,” one person wrote in the YouTube comments.

Cam isn’t backing down and promised to be in attendance at WrestleMania 42 on Saturday night at Allegiant Stadium. “Yo Uce Count Ya Days,” he captioned the clip of the altercation on IG.

Uso is slated to team up with his twin brother, Jimmy Uso, and LA Knight to take on streamer iShowSpeed, who’s joined forces with WWE Tag Team Champions Logan Paul and The Vision’s Austin Theory.

Watch the full interview with Jey Uso below. The WWE star’s attack on Cam takes place just shy of the 15-minute mark.
